title: Poisson (PHD) set likelihood of the ground-truth lane points under the node-edge intensity replaces the clamped hinge recall term (4 u fine-tune of the fast variant j1 192 / 96)

a.recipe: p16_train.py --design D7 --init e123_D7_r3_j1 --u 4 --lr 0.0005 --stem_lr 0.3 --warm_frac 0.4 --set <j1 config as _run_j1eq.sh> --w phd=0.3 rec=0 ; seeds 0 and 1; evaluated at tau 0.5, fork_prune 0.4

b.recipe: as a but the OLD hinge recall (rec=1) with the clamp lifted from 3 m to 8 m (env P19_REC_CLAMP=8), phd=0; isolates the dead zone from the form of the loss

c.recipe: existing equal-budget control: e18_D7_j1eq (seed 0) and e18_D7_j1eqs1 (seed 1), recall weight 1, same 4 u recipe; tau = better of 0.5 / 0.7 on VAL seed 0 (pre-declared)

r.recipe: existing reference j1rc / j1rcs1 (recall weight 3, registry fast_recall)

rule.note: headline, beyond the band against the equal-budget control
better than the recall weight 3 fine-tune j1rc

kill: toy test fails; < 15 % of the missed far points in the dead zone and arm b not the explanation; after 1 u (1200 steps) val250 lanes found more than 0.03 below j1 or loss not finite; Q of a below c - 0.010 after both seeds
